Usage: simdbench [flags]

Quick comparison on 1,048,576 float32 elements; -list inspects without measuring.

Options:
  -addition
    	alias for -group addition
  -alpha value
    	float32 scale/affine multiplier (broadcast per call) (default 1.5)
  -beta value
    	float32 affine offset (unfused) (default -0.5)
  -computation
    	alias for -group computation
  -function string
    	deprecated alias: add, compute, or all
  -group string
    	operation group (use -list to see available groups) (default "all")
  -list
    	list implemented kernels and runtime capabilities without benchmarking
  -lower value
    	float32 exclusive lower range bound (default -1)
  -pattern string
    	predicate fixture: none, all, alternating, clustered, shuffled (default "alternating")
  -seed uint
    	deterministic shuffled predicate seed (default 42)
  -threshold value
    	float32 threshold for threshold/selection
  -upper value
    	float32 exclusive upper range bound (default 1)

Examples:
  simdbench -list
  simdbench -group addition
  simdbench -group computation
